review_rules: Cargo package.license, package.license-file, SPDX-only headers, filenames and URLs are declarations/references, not complete actual grants.
Retained text needs a clear actual grant permitting copying/redistribution, its conditions/disclaimer and applicable copyright/attribution notices.
Require exact archive member path, byte count, SHA256 and available checksum association; no crate/version or source-root license inference alone.
For a grant inside README/source, retain only a clearly bounded complete license/notice span with byte offsets and full-member identity; unreviewed surrounding content stays private.
Unknown, custom, absent, incomplete, reference-only or ambiguous applicability stays UNRESOLVED.
Text presence and checksum joins do not establish all files covered, legal acceptance, source/build correspondence or release eligibility.
root_notice_scope: These texts are retained for their stated source-root/component scope. They do not automatically grant rights in each vendored crate.
scope: exact119 vendored components missed by original license-name predicate; content review only
